title: The Security Shield Architecture
facebook_comment_text: 💡 Beyond perimeter firewalls, the real engineering reality is that even encrypted data can be compromised if underlying infrastructure ports have unpatched vulnerabilities or misconfigurations. Continuous vulnerability scanning and a proactive patching regimen are non-negotiable. What's your biggest challenge in maintaining a watertight 'no-blind-spots' port security posture? 👇
